 Published on : 04-02-2026 02:22 pm 
 NAGALAND PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION 
 KOHIMA 
 Dated Kohima, the 4 th 
February, 2026 
 Corrigendum 
 NO.NPSC/EXAM-5/2025:: Reference
to the Commission’s Advertisement NO.NPSC-2/NCS -2025 dt. 28 th October,
2025 the Pay Level for the post
of Item No. 15 Social Study Instructor
(Allied Instructor) , (Class-III Non Gazetted), under the Labour
and Employment, Skill Development & Entrepreneurship Department, is Level-10 as per the Department’s letter No. EMP-2/147/2013
(Pt)/255 dt. 19 th December, 2025 
 Other terms and conditions remain
the same. 
 (NUNGSANGMENLA IMCHEN) 
 Secretary, 
 Nagaland Public Service Commission
